widget.doc: A single choice as a grid of equal chips (time slots, sizes, a finish; not tabs or a filter: those are Tabs, Segments and ChipTabs): ChoiceChips bind:time options:["18:00","18:30"] disabled:["18:30"] keeps the chosen chip's text in your variable; disabled lists the ones that are unavailable (full, sold out); columns sets chips per row. Labels too long for that many columns are not squeezed: the chips are then as wide as their labels and wrap.

props.doc: The name of your text variable: it holds the chosen option.
The options, one chip each: short (a time, a size, a word).
The options that cannot be chosen (full time slots, sizes out of stock): greyed and struck through.

events.doc: A chip was chosen; the value is its text.

bind.data: ${= (max(1, props.columns) * (first(sortByDesc(map(props.options, o => length(o)), n => n)) * 7.5 + 24 + 8) - 8 <= min(screen.width, 420) - 56) ? props.options : []}
bind.visible: ${= (max(1, props.columns) * (first(sortByDesc(map(props.options, o => length(o)), n => n)) * 7.5 + 24 + 8) - 8 <= min(screen.width, 420) - 56)}

bind.decoration.fills[0].color: ${= contains(props.disabled, item) ? theme.colors.tile : props.value == item ? theme.colors.accent : theme.colors.card}
bind.decoration.strokes[0].color: ${= contains(props.disabled, item) ? theme.colors.tile : props.value == item ? theme.colors.accent : theme.colors.lineStrong}

bind.props.style.color: ${= contains(props.disabled, item) ? theme.colors.inkGhost : props.value == item ? theme.colors.onAccent : theme.colors.ink}

bind.data: ${= (max(1, props.columns) * (first(sortByDesc(map(props.options, o => length(o)), n => n)) * 7.5 + 24 + 8) - 8 <= min(screen.width, 420) - 56) ? [] : props.options}
bind.visible: ${= !(max(1, props.columns) * (first(sortByDesc(map(props.options, o => length(o)), n => n)) * 7.5 + 24 + 8) - 8 <= min(screen.width, 420) - 56)}

bind.decoration.fills[0].color: ${= contains(props.disabled, item) ? theme.colors.tile : props.value == item ? theme.colors.accent : theme.colors.card}
bind.decoration.strokes[0].color: ${= contains(props.disabled, item) ? theme.colors.tile : props.value == item ? theme.colors.accent : theme.colors.lineStrong}

bind.props.style.color: ${= contains(props.disabled, item) ? theme.colors.inkGhost : props.value == item ? theme.colors.onAccent : theme.colors.ink}
